subject: how to prevent mplusModeler() run all mplus input files in the same directory?

messages.author: 52fd5dedb1e045f9
messages.subject: how to prevent mplusModeler() run all mplus input files in the same directory?
parts:
Usually I run several SEM models one by one using `mplusModeler()`, and I'd like to put all mplus syntax files into one foler. How ever, I see that `mplusModeler()` will run all the input files within the directory. Is there any way to tell mplusModeler() to run jun the syntax file indicated by its `object` argument? Perhaps setting the `filefilter` argument of `runModels` will do the trick?

Any thoughts to fix this?

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] how to prevent mplusModeler() run all mplus input files in the same directory?
parts:
Dear Huashan Chen,

There was not a way, but using filefilter is a good suggestion.  I added that and tests seem good so that feature is added to the latest version on github now.

Thanks for the feedback and thoughts!

Cheers,

Josh

Instruction to install the development version below:


#install.packages("devtools")
require(devtools)

install_github("MplusAutomation", "michaelhallquist")
